verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਖਰ ਬੋਲ ਸੁਨਿ ਸਗੁਨੀਆ ਮਾਨ ਲੇਤ ਗੁਨ ਅਵਗੁਨ ਤਾਂ ਕੋ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਬਿਚਾਰ ਹੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise khar bol sun saguneeaa maan let gun avagun taa(n) ko kachhoo na bichaar hee ||

en.bdb: Just as a believer of omens, regards braying of a donkey as a good omen, but pays no attention to the donkey's good or bad qualities.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਨਾਦ ਸੁਨਿ ਸਹੈ ਸਨਮੁਖ ਬਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਦੇਤ ਬਧਿਕ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਨ ਸਮਾਰ ਹੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise mirag naadh sun sahai sanamukh baan praan dhet badhik biradh na samaar hee ||

en.bdb: Just as a deer, attracted by the music of Ghanda Hehra rushes towards its source and is killed by the hunter's arrow, but it does not ponder over his killer qualities.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਨਤ ਜੁਝਾਊ ਜੈਸੇ ਜੂਝੈ ਜੋਧਾ ਜੁਧ ਸਮੈ ਢਾਡੀ ਕੋ ਨ ਬਰਨ ਚਿਹਨ ਉਰ ਧਾਰ ਹੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: sunat jujhaauoo jaise joojhai jodhaa judh samai ddaaddee ko na baran chihan ur dhaar hee ||

en.bdb: Just as a battle warrior rushes into the battlefield on hearing the sound of war-drums that fills him with excitement, but he does not bring the form or colour of the drummer in his mind.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਨਾਇ ਗਾਇ ਸਿਖ ਠਗੋ ਭੇਖ ਧਾਰੀ ਜਾਨਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਨ ਬਿਡਾਰ ਹੀ ॥੬੧੧॥
verses.translit_en: taise gur sabadh sunai gai sikh Thago bhekh dhaaree jaan moh maar na biddaar hee ||611||

en.bdb: Similarly, I a cheat different from inside and outside swindle gullible Sikhs by singing to them the sacred hymns of the Guru. But those Sikhs enamoured by the sweetness of Gurbani and of very generous nature, don't even scold me despite them knowing that I am a fake Sikh.  (611)
